purpose: Execute a safe, bounded JSON query over normalized canonical LIVE data.
parameters: request (object/dict, required): versioned safe canonical-query request payload conforming to the contract discovered via describe_canonical_state. Must explicitly include schema_version, language_version, root, filters, and select. May include limit (default 20, max 200) and evidence_limit (default 3, None for full nested evidence).
behavior: 1. Validates the request against the safe canonical query DSL without arbitrary code execution or eval.
2. Filters are flat AND clauses using field operators declared by describe_canonical_state. Empty filters match all records; empty select returns all selectable fields.
3. Language 1.1 supports nested evidence bounding via evidence_limit (default 3) and emits imports_truncated or consumers_truncated metadata.
4. Responses always include total_matches, returned, limit, and truncated metadata.
5. Reads authoritative canonical LIVE state. Invalid requests fail closed with structured error diagnostics.
errors:
The executor first converts LIVE state to read-only JSON-safe records. It
never uses ``eval``, accepts no Python expressions, exposes no arbitrary
attributes and omits local absolute paths. Artifacts preserve the
distinction between confirmed zero consumers and unavailable consumption
data via ``consumer_data_available`` plus nullable consumer fields.
Structural errors return one deterministic error with ``code``, ``path``
and repair details.
usage_notes:
LLM use: discover the contract first via ``describe_canonical_state(schema_version='1.1', language_version='1.1')``,
request the smallest useful field selection, and narrow filters when ``truncated`` is
true. Use ``evidence_limit=None`` only when complete nested evidence is required.
